feedback.empty: Soon, the first reviews from our guests will appear here.

testimonials.name: Isabela Santos
testimonials.quote: My experience was great because I felt so welcome and well received. The rooms are wonderful and we arrived to a harm-reduction kit and gifts. I felt like I was with my family at a country home. The hosts (Hudson and Letícia) are amazing. I will definitely go with Way Home to Tomorrowland 2025 and other festivals.

testimonials.name: Alan Moreira
testimonials.quote: No words to describe my experience at Way Home. Breakfast every day, transfers to Tomorrowland, a lively crowd and everything well organized by the staff. There was even a recovery kit. It was awesome 💯💯

testimonials.name: Wendell de Camillo
testimonials.quote: Tomorrowland has always been a dream since I was young, and being able to live it here where I was born with my best friends made it even more special. From the moment I stepped into Way Home it felt like home. Everything was flawless from start to finish.

testimonials.name: Bruna
testimonials.quote: It was a very comfortable experience. The Way Home team was very welcoming, helpful and attentive so we could live the best of the festival.

testimonials.name: Sarah Carvalho
testimonials.quote: I highly recommend Way Home. My stay during Tomorrowland was wonderful: nice people, spacious rooms with private bathrooms, a lively and organized team. The Way Home gifts were thoughtfully designed to avoid trouble during the event. 10/10!

testimonials.name: Helena
testimonials.quote: Just want to thank Way Home for this incredible experience! You thought of every detail. The gifts, welcome kit, harm-reduction kit, breakfast and snacks were great! Clean and tidy room with private bathroom. The patience, care and communication were excellent! Thank you ✨✨

items.q: What is included in the Way Home package?
items.a: Lodging, round-trip transfer to the festival, breakfast and 24/7 support during your stay. Specific details vary by package.

items.q: How does the open bar during transfers work?
items.a: We serve selected drinks (beer, vodka, gin, energy drinks, soda and water) during travel to and from the festival, always responsibly.

items.q: Can I cancel and get a refund?
items.a: Yes, within 7 days of purchase (Brazilian CDC, art. 49) if the event is more than 30 days away. After that, package-specific policy (shown at checkout) applies.
After payment approval you'll get an email with receipt and details. Everything is also available under Account → Orders.
Pix, credit card (single or installments) and boleto via Mercado Pago and partners.
No — Way Home packages follow the Tomorrowland Brasil age rating (minimum 18 years old).
Show a photo ID at the lodging reception. Your reservation is linked to your account.

items.q: What if a problem happens during the event?
items.a: The Way Home team is available 24/7 at the lodging and via WhatsApp. Just look for any identified team member.
